digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and G7 enablement
propositions: G7 routing entry currently has default_posture 'advisory' at block_threshold 0.95, preventing plan-review blocking despite 22/29 historical high-priority findings (>= 0.75) being correct, matching the bfa8/c97a pattern requiring a routing flip to enable blocking

At 0.85 blocking threshold, floor-grade kinds (contradicts_reality and omits_required_site) achieve impact 0.85+ via the existing plan-v4 divergence grading, while incomplete_enumeration contributes only 0.55 and cannot block, naturally scoping the blocker set without per-grade Pass-3 gating

Unresolvable parents currently emit findings instead of abstaining with coverage (ticket 18f9), and same-clause contradictions stack as multiple findings (ticket 76d2 had 3 for one parent) — both fixed via rubric FAIL-OPEN abstain pattern and DEDUP-AT-SOURCE one-per-clause guidance
Closed parents must be checked against final state, and scope handed to siblings is not a leaf violation (consistent narrowing remains non-blocking) — requires rubric clarification, not code changes
The 0.80-0.85 quantization band is empty and 0.80 threshold exposes future validity-0.80 findings with no historical quality evidence, so 0.85 is the threshold with FP support and minimal future risk
